Course Participant: Elena K. Fontaine
Training Outline Title: Logistics Analyst Track
Duration: 8 weeks

Week 1 (Mar 2 - Mar 6): Supply Chain Basics
Day 1: Supply chain overview; Inventory concepts
Day 2: Mastering Trello; Kanban for logistics teams
Day 3: MS Excel for logistics; Lookup functions

Week 2 (Mar 9 - Mar 13): Warehouse Operations (40 hours)
Objective: Explain receiving, put-away, picking, and shipping flows.
Day 1: Warehouse layout principles; Safety fundamentals
Day 2: WMS software tour; Barcode scanning workflow
